platform: Linux arm64 inside Podman on macOS

build.dependencies: existing pinned ARM64 BoringSSL/nghttp2/Brotli static cache
build.scope: changed engine/fixture/integration/relay targets rebuilt; unchanged CTest targets reused from same dependency cache

http1MultiPeerWanAndReloadInitialGroup.note: includes first four liveReload tests; do not add counts as independent coverage

clockDataPlaneProfileComboTransparent.failureReason: runner lacked TUN device and writable namespace sysctls

checked: add without restarting engine or reconnecting unchanged packet client
reject duplicate peers, missing key and immutable setting changes
combo rejects uninitialized relay replay state before packet peer publication
rotate key and revoke close old packet identities
deny all through empty peers and restore standalone transparent peers
raw-config SHA256 and successful revision acknowledgements
relay workers from same source address retain quotas for unchanged identity
revoked relay workers cancel and denied fresh identity opens no origin
durable replay retained without reopening locked journals
same relay key cannot move to new replay path
real REDIRECT and no-direct-fallback regression in isolated namespaces
profile fingerprints, HRR, ALPS, ML-DSA, authentication and clock regressions
limitations: local Linux lab, no physical deployment or WAN benchmark
packet reload uses fixture packet boundary, not host routes
signal publication acknowledgement is not a wait for all cancelled relay workers to exit
relay limits and non-peer engine settings require separate lifecycle change
controller must serialize file updates and match journal acknowledgement
old daily binaries do not gain reload support until separately updated
